title: Project published cluster runs into current-visible leaderboard and passage data
description:
Purpose: shared public-data boundary for later local/API cluster pages and maps. Prerequisites accepted immutable runs and privatepublicationregistry. Allowed only new analysis/apricity_analyze/cluster_exploration.py and test_cluster_exploration.py; root registersCI. No registry/manifests/HTTP/UI/cloud/model/dependency changes or autoapprove/publish. Inject trusted published-only registry, current semantic corpus/catalog providers, mandatory canonical visibility policy callable and current ratings provider. Never use trusted-local visibility=None for publicdata. Providers freshly read per invocation; no crossrequest content cache. Independent trusted enabled=False blocks all publicoperations503 before providers; draft/missingrun404 structured, corrupt/outage503 sanitized no private content.

Contracts: leaderboard(runId optional,preset useful default,order samples|clips) resolves explicit publishedrun or latestpublished preset via registry, validates immutable manifest, rebuilds current-valid deduplicated snapshot with exact manifestspace/fingerprint and mandatoryvisibility using existing freshness validator. Only currentvalid member semanticIds/aliases present in that publishedrun are included; boundary/audio/model/gridrevision/deletion/hidden failures excluded. Never mix run membership across versions. Recompute eachcluster distinctsampleCount and savedclipCount over visiblealiases, exclude emptyclusters, order selected countdesc then clusterId stable. Return runId preset algorithmVersions safeclusterlabels/counts and up to4 current playable approvedrepresentatives percluster; curator labeloverride from reviewed publication audit takesprecedence, suggestedlabel remains clearlysuggested. No storedcentroid/vector/private reviewaudit/curatoridentity/raw draft data.

Detail(runId optional,preset,clusterId,order similarity|rating): representatives first where stillvisible, no hiddenrepresentative titles or archivedplayback fallback. Current cards from canonicalmetadata matchedranges parentrecording/sample/cliplinks; remainingmembers similaritydescending (currentstoredvector dot immutablecentroid internal) or existing currentratingdescending stablesemanticIdties; scores ranking values not percentages. Include explicitoutlier grouping only as outliers notfabricatedcluster. Map(runId,preset,limit default10000 max10000) emits safe currentvisible coordinates and identitycardlinks with displayedCount/totalVisibleCount/truncated, deterministic selection and novectors; callerlistalternative uses same membership. Validate bounded integerlimit/enums safe64hex IDs, malformed unknown returns400/404. Regions dedup but all currentaliases contribute distinctcounts, eachrepresentativeplayback exacttime. Olderpublishedrun addressable when newerpointer changes; unrelated corpus changes must filter affectedmembers not hide all olderpublishedruns.

Fixtures genuine prepare/save/publish syntheticcuratorapprovedtestonly plus fixed512vectors/currentcatalog/ratings, multirecordings windows/savedclips aliases/outliers malformedstates. REDfirst observabletests. Verify focusedexploration/publication/corpus/run pytest rootcwd allpassnoskips; noactualrealqualityapproval. comments.author: home
comments.text: Preliminary supervisor proof: invalid runId ../invalid produces ExplorationStorageUnavailable503 because _safe_id runs inside broad registry try/catch. Validation must preserve structured400 before provider calls. Bookmark routes carry run AND preset; supervisor contract clarification accept matching explicit run/preset and reject mismatched preset400, rather than reject every combined selection. Published boundary must also validate approved review status/revision/representative coverage and not trust a malformed audit as publication. Root will review full lifecycle/alias/mapcap/order tests after terminal handoff; existing2test draft not sufficient final evidence.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Terminal handoff reviewed but not accepted: only two new tests do not prove declared lifecycle/privacy/order/map contracts. Correct invalid run validation being converted to 503; accept matching run and preset bookmark selection; validate approved publication review and representative coverage. Missing ratings currently emit negative infinity as score, which is not valid JSON: define finite or null missing-rating representation and strict serialization test. Include canonical parent links and comprehensive deterministic fixtures, actual capped map versus uncapped list, aliases/outliers/current visibility and freshness, storage failures and old published runs. Return RED/GREEN and focused suite evidence; no actual real-run approval/publication.

right_now_summary: The team is revising validation and tests for public cluster data before accepting the implementation.
